The thick, irregular ring enhancement (`Thickness of enhancing margin`: ">3mm", `Enhancement Quality`: "Marked") is the archetypal appearance of a grade 4 glioma. There is no evidence to support a lower grade; grade 2 tumors are typically non-enhancing, and grade 3 tumors usually lack extensive, organized central necrosis.
